workarounds.symptom: AMD Radeon 780M Vulkan regression in Ollama >=0.32.10
workarounds.workaround: Fix: llm: use mmap for Vulkan integrated GPUs. Target files: llm/llama_server.go, llm/llama_server_test.go. Non-mmap loads put CPU-resident tensors in the Vulkan host buffer, which is drawn from the same device budget as the weights. On a shared-memory iGPU that roughly doubles the footprint and the load fails with "Failed to allocate pinned memory" or, on Windows AMD, 0xe06d7363. workarounds.symptom: batch(by_column=...) merges different groups when the key column contains nulls
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix batch(by_column=) merging groups that are separated by null values. Target files: src/datasets/table.py, tests/test_arrow_dataset.py. `Dataset.batch(by_column=...)` and `IterableDataset.batch(by_column=...)` treated a null key as equal to its neighbours, so different groups were merged into one batch. Keys `[1, None, 2]` gave a single batch. A key column with only nulls raised `ArrowNotImplementedError`. Now a null is its own value: equal to other nulls, different from any non-null value. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/datasets/pull/8966)
